Here’s a concise profile of Arian Kabashi (footballer, born 1996):

- Identity: Swedish professional footballer of Albanian/Kosovar descent.
- Position: Forward/winger (attacking role across the front line; often used as a mobile, pressing forward who runs in behind and attacks the box).
- Foot: Right-footed.
- Notable traits: Pace, direct runs, work rate in the press, willingness to attack space; has been used both centrally and off the flank.

Career overview (senior):
- Dalkurd FF (Sweden) – early senior years in Superettan; part of the Borlänge football scene where many players of Albanian/Kosovar background featured.
- IK Brage (Sweden) – established himself in Superettan; known for important goals and consistency, contributing to Brage’s strong seasons and promotion push/playoff contention.
- IF Elfsborg (Allsvenskan) – moved up to Sweden’s top tier; featured in the squad during Elfsborg’s strong 2020 campaign (club finished as Allsvenskan runners-up that season). Used across the front line; battled for minutes amid competition and some fitness interruptions.
- Helsingborgs IF (Sweden) – transferred in 2022; joined to bolster the attack in Allsvenskan; remained part of the setup as the club navigated relegation and subsequent Superettan play.

International status:
- Eligible for Sweden and Kosovo (and often associated with the Kosovar/Albanian diaspora in Swedish football).
- As of my latest knowledge, no senior competitive caps.

General notes:
- There is also another professional footballer named Arian Kabashi (born 1997). Your query specifies the 1996-born player—the Swedish-based forward tied to Dalkurd/Brage/Elfsborg/Helsingborg.
